title: fonderie.download: ugly-beautiful display faces, all free
note: Seven display faces, all under the WTFPL (use them for anything): 4 Fromages (drippy, tribal-calligraphic ligatures), Beast (chunky pixel slab), Crédible, Garamon(d/t) (a rough wobbly Garamond revival), Quarantype (mixed-up ornamental caps made during lockdown), Tribalium Neue and Zara (a quirky sans with spiky caps, drawn on a FlixBus trip). The 4 Fromages page fills the screen with a wall of the font and a fake 3D software box on top. None of them are body faces. Worth reusing: one of these as a single loud headline or logo against a plain grotesk, the way GASS pairs a neutral sans with one ornate face (lib-gass-type).
